limits: Real Android ART and native Compose behavior with synthetic card/config state only; no real SIM, ePDG authentication, carrier registration, physical cross-chip switching, call or audio was attempted.
SMS entry is rendered in an independent Compose host using the real app theme; full messaging-page navigation was not tested.
Protocol helper tests do not execute full o82.h/r dispatchers on ART; full native dispatcher checks are separate host tests.
No production APK change was made to address fixture initialization, UI-action or comparison mistakes.
